##### Project general facts

Samana Boulevard Heights is a refined residential development located in the one of Dubai’s most thoughtfully planned communities. Defined by symmetry, clean proportions, and refined details, the architecture reflects a quiet confidence, creating a visual harmony that stands out while blending seamlessly into its surroundings. More than a home, this is a sanctuary for families seeking balance, where every space blends sophistication with comfort, ensuring life's quiet moments are cherished as much as its biggest celebrations.

Every amenity at Samana Boulevard Heights is a reflection of thoughtful living. Residents enjoy a state-of-the-art gym, an outdoor swimming pool, a jogging track, a sun deck, a shaded lounge deck, and an outdoor cinema. Private pools bring the essence of resort living to the doorstep. Whether seeking movement, mindfulness, or meaningful time with loved ones, this is where convenience meets calm and where life feels complete.

Every detail within these walls has been curated for comfort and calm. Neutral palettes, soft textures, and contemporary finishes shape a space that feels both luxurious and homely. Open layouts encourage movement, while thoughtful detailing ensures a feeling of lasting comfort and understated luxury. The interiors are designed for how residents truly live, making everyday routines become cherished rituals.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Dubai Land Residence Complex, this exceptional location is ideally situated between Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, Emirates Road, and Dubai-Al Ain Road, providing unrivaled connectivity to the city's business, social, and leisure hubs. Wide boulevards, open greens, and an abundance of urban conveniences reflect a new way of living — balanced between connection and calm.

The location is distinguished by its proximity to leading universities, schools, shopping destinations, and social attractions. Global Village, Dubai Outlet Mall, IMG World, Mirdif City Centre, Dubai Airport, Dubai Mall, Miracle Garden, and Burj Khalifa are all within easy reach. In this community, every journey begins and ends with ease, allowing residents to stay close to the city's pulse yet comfortably away from the rush.

For those seeking a residence that embodies timeless modernity, community spirit, and a prime Dubai address, Dubai Land Residence Complex delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of open spaces, family-friendly amenities, and strategic connectivity makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where life flows effortlessly between work, wellness, and leisure — serene, connected and effortlessly refined.
